data.gender_notes: Gangadev is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gangadev is the deity of the Ganga river, revered in Hindu mythology for his association with the river goddess Ganga. He is believed to purify the soul and bestow prosperity and good fortune upon devotees. The name Gangadev carries the meaning “God of the Ganga River” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gangadev usually hope their child will grow to embody god of the ganga river and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of purification and spiritual growth
data.etymology: Gangadev belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of the Ganga River.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gangadev total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: Gangadev's name is deeply rooted in Indian culture and mythology, particularly associated with the holy Ganga river. The river Ganga is considered the most sacred and purifying waterbody in Hinduism, and Gangadev is the embodiment of the river's divine essence. Thousands of pilgrims visit various Ganga ghats every year to take a dip in the holy waters, seeking blessings from Gangadev.
data.spiritual_significance: For Hindus, Gangadev signifies the purifying power of the sacred Ganges river. It is believed that by bathing in the Ganges or offering prayers to Gangadev, one can cleanse their soul of impurities and attain spiritual growth and enlightenment. The name 'Gangadev' thus holds immense spiritual significance in Hinduism, symbolizing the divine power of the river and the Almighty God who embodies it.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Gangadev: God of the Ganges River. Symbolizes the divine presence and purifying power of the river Ganges. Embodiment of grace, strength, and spiritual transformation.

historical_references.reference: Gangadev was a prominent Hindu king of the Chalukya dynasty, reigning from 1118 to 1142 CE. During his rule, he expanded the Chalukyan empire in the Deccan region of India, winning several battles against the Western Chalukyas and the Hoysalas.

Another Gangadev, a Jain monk, was a renowned philosopher and scholar of the 15th century. He was a disciple of the famous Jain philosopher and scholar, Sachchandadevi. Gangadev wrote several significant works on Jain philosophy, including the commentary on the 'Ratnasangraha'.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Gangadev continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
